BTS Group Organises the “Clean Air We Share” Campaign Distributing 2,050 Free Air-Purifying Plants, Reinforcing Commitment to Driving Thailand Towards Net Zero by 2050

Back 07 September 2026

7 September 2026 – BTS Group Holdings and subsidiaries jointly organised the "Clean Air We Share" campaign under the theme "Move Green, Earn Green, Grow Green: Moving Towards Net Zero by 2050." As part of the initiative, BTS Group distributed 2,050 air-purifying plants free of charge to passengers and members of the public at Ha Yaek Lat Phrao Station (N9). The campaign aims to encourage public participation in environmental stewardship, raise awareness of the importance of air quality, and support efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and PM2.5 pollution. These efforts form part of BTS Group's commitment to helping drive Thailand towards its goal of achieving Net Zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050.

The event was attended by executives and representatives from across the BTS Group and its subsidiaries, including Mr. Marut Arthakaivalvatee and Mr. Chan Kin Tak of VGI Public Company Limited, Mr. Daniel Ross of BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited, Mr. Sumit Srisantithum of Bangkok Mass Transit System Public Company Limited, Ms. Chalida Bhuvadejsirivoradee of Rabbit Holdings Public Company Limited, Mr. Weng Sam Lam and Ms. Tamonwan Narintavanich of ROCTEC Global Public Company Limited, Mr. Yotin Thavikulwat of Super Turtle Public Company Limited, Mr. Thanongsak Chupongwattana of Turtle 23 Company Limited, Mr. Chalermporn Luangtimakul of Rabbit Life Insurance Public Company Limited, and Ms. Ratprapa Krasaesin of Rabbit Group. This reflects the strong collaboration across BTS Group companies in driving a low-carbon society. Together, they aim to raise awareness of the importance of clean air, promote a better quality of life, and encourage environmental stewardship, as part of the collective effort to build a sustainable future.

Beyond helping to increase green spaces and improve air quality in urban areas, the campaign also encourages greater environmental consciousness among all sectors of society and highlights the importance of reducing greenhouse gas emissions. BTS Group would like to thank all participants for joining this meaningful initiative and for being part of the collective effort to drive Thailand towards its Net Zero target by 2050 and build a sustainable future together.
